tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// dpal 'khor la sdom pa'i rin chen bzhi'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru tsakra sam+ba rā ya/ rab mdzes in+d+ra nī la'i sa 'dzin la// mtshams sprin gsar pas 'khyud pa'i mdzes sdug can// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med bcom ldan 'das// 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la btud nas// de yi gsang sngags rin chen rnam pa bzhi// legs par btus nas skal ldan slob ma'i rgyud// byin gyis brlab phyir rjes gnang cho ga'i tshul// brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag len gsal bar bya// 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rin chen bzhi'i sngags btu'i rjes gnang bya tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug chog go /dang po la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i sngon 'gro dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro'o// dang po ni/ dbang thob cing dam sdom la gnas pa/ bsnyen pa song zhing sngags btu'i rjes gnang legs par thob pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis gnas khang bdud rtsi lnga dang ba byung gis byugs pa la me tog gi sil ma gcal du dgram/ rdo dril/ cang te'u/ las bum/ phyi nang gi mchod pa/ gtor ma/ tshogs rdzas/ bgegs sbyong gi chas/ 'thor 'bru sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad spyi dang*/ khyad par ras gzhi sogs bri gzhi gtsang ma la/ 'og tu bshad pa'i snag smyug gis/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga pa dang bshad rgyud kha sbyor gung bsgrigs pa'i dgongs pa ltar chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a thung*/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar nas g.yas skor du a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha'i sde tshan brgyad dbu phyir bstan du dpe'u chung ltar bris la/ stegs kyi khar chos 'byung gi zur gcig dang shar 'dab rang la phyogs par bzhag pa'i shar nas g.yon skor du chu bzhi nyer spyod mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog gis bskor ba bsham/

dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i gong ngam skabs 'dir bdag bskyed gtor 'bul nyer bsdu'i bar gtang ba dang*/ bsang chu sgrub pa rnams bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i sngon 'gro ni/ bde mchog ci rigs kyi dbang thob pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma la/ khrus phyag maṇ+ḍal bgegs sbyong chos bshad ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje 'dzin// dpa' bo rnal 'byor kun gyi gtso// dpal chen he ru ka dpal gyi// rig sngags bla na med pa'i gsung*// bklags pas don kun grub byed cing*// dbang du byed pa'i rig sngags mchog /gsang ba'i cho ga bla na med// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// ces gsol ba lan gsum 'debs su bcug la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa 'bog go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ sngags btu gzhi las ji ltar btu ba/ sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa/ sngags kyi rjes gnang bya tshul lo// dang po la bzhi/ rtsa ba'i sngags btu ba/ yab kyi snying po dang nye snying btu ba/ yum gyi snying po dang nye snying btu ba/ yab yum gyi go cha'i sngags gnyis btu ba'o// dang po la gsum/ rkang brgyad kyi rtsa sngags btu ba/ ka ra ka ra'i rtsa sngags btu ba/ rtsa sngags kyi thog mtha'i yi ge btu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ rkang pa sngon ma bzhi btu ba dang*/ rkang pa phyi ma bzhi btu ba'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis gzhung tshig rnams dag par bklags pa'i brjod don dang mthun par/ las kyi rdo rjes spang leb bam maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa la/ sin+dhū ra/ gur gum/ gi'u waṃ/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams mtshal dang bsres pa'i snag tsa dang*/ gser ram mi rus sogs kyi smyu gus dbus su oṃ gyi shul stong par bzhag de nas yi ge rnams dbu nang du bstan nas g.yon skor du rim pa bzhin du dag par bri/ de'i tshe btu gzhi ā li kā li'i dkyil 'khor las sngags kyi yig 'bru rnams mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung nas 'khod par bsam mo// gzhung tshig ni/

rgyud dang dgongs 'grel phal cher du dang por lus gsal byed btus pa bris/ de nas yan lag dbyangs btus pa lus dang sbyor bar gsungs pa bzhin byas na 'khrul nyen shin tu che bas/ bdag gi bla ma rje yongs 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po'i bzhed pa ltar gsal byed gang yin gyi thad du rang rang gi dbyangs dang sbyar te 'thu ba la/ rtsa rgyud le'u lnga pa las/ bzhi pa'i lnga pa

na gang yin dang*// lnga pa yi yang lnga pa dang*// le'u bdun pa las/ de nas dbyangs yig bcu gsum nyid// yi ge gnyis pa da mo ga dang sbyar// lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa bha dang*// dang po'i gsum pa ga gang yin dang*// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa dgu pa lwa // bzhi pa'i dang po gang yin dang*// dbyangs yig bcu gcig yang dang ldan// yi ge drug pa te brgyan par bya// mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa dang*// dbyangs kyi bzhi pa nyid kyang ni// yi ge bdun pa wī nyid dang sbyar// de nyid kyi ni gnyis pa dang*// dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa nyid ni// mkhas pas yi ge brgyad par re bya// sum cu pa ni yang dag blang*// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan par// yi ge dgu pa shā brgyan par bya// de bzhin nyi shu drug pa ya nyid// de dag thams cad legs bsdus la/ ༈ de bzhin brgya yi phyed phyed ma kyang*// de nas sum cu rtsa gsum gzung*// dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis pa nyid// yi ge bcu gnyis pa hā dang sbyar// dang po'i dang ka po nyid dag dang*// mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang*// dbyangs yig gnyis par ldan pa ni// yi ge nyi shu gcig par gzung*// mkhas pas yi ge bcu bzhi pa wā 'o// dang po yi ni gsum pa nyid// yi ge nyi shu pa dang sbyar// dbyangs kyi gsum pa nyid dag ni// yi ge bco lnga pa g+ni dang sbyar// sum cu rtsa gnyis nyid dag dang*// dbyangs yig bco lngar yang dag ldan// yi ge bcu drug pa mdzes bya// bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang*// dbyangs yig gsum pa dang ldan pa'i// yi ge bcu bdun pa ni ru 'dod// lnga pa'i yang ni bzhi pa dang*// dbyangs kyi gnyis pa nyid dang ni// yi ge bco brgyad pa bhā ru sbyar// mthar gnas pa yi dang po ya dang*// gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dza dang*// gsum pa'i dang po gang yin dang*// dbyangs yig gi ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge nyi shu gcig par ṭāng ldan// lnga pa yi yang lnga pa ma dang*// dang po yi yang dang po dang*// dbyangs yig lnga pa nyid dang ni// yi ge nyi shu gsum pa

ku sbyar// de bzhin bcu gcig pa nyid dang*// dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa nyid ni// yi ge nyi shu bzhi par ṭo sbyar// de bzhin mkhas pas bcu drug pa// sde tshan dang po blangs nas ni// yi ge nyi shu lnga par t+kā sbyar// gsum pa'i dang po gang yin dang*// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan par// yi ge nyi shu rtsa drug ṭā 'gyur// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa drug ya pa// bzhi pa'i gsum pa gang yin dang*// dbyangs yig bco lnga pa dag ni// nyi shu brgyad pa daṃ nyid dang sbyar// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi gnyis pa nyid// gsum pa'i dang po yang dag ldan// 'og ma'i char ni me dang bcas// de bzhin dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar// yi ge nyi shu dgu ṣ+ṭā pa'o// dang po'i dang po ka gang yin dang*// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bdun pa// yi ge sum cu rtsa gcig pa// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dag dang sbyar// nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa yang ngo*// yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pa// dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa lo dang sbyar// dang po yi ni gsum pa dang*// yi ge sum cu rtsa gsum pa// nyi mar yang dag ldan par bya// lnga pa yi yang bzhi pa dang*// dbyangs yig bzhi pa nyid dang ni// yi ge sum cu bzhir ldan pa// 'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed yin// de bzhin sum cu rtsa gcig ṣa blang*// bco lnga pa ṇa ni nyid dag dang*// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa lnga pa// dbyangs kyi lnga pa nyid dag ni// sum cu bdun par yang dag ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams sgrub byed yin// dang po'i gnyis pa gang yin dang*// sum cu brgyad ṣā pa 'di dag ni// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba// lha rnams thams cad sgrub pa ni// 'di nyid yin par the tshom med// ces pa dang*/ de bzhin nyi shu rtsa drug pa ya // zhes pa'o// gnyis pa rkang pa phyi ma bzhi btu ba ni// yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis sa dang*// ūṣ+ma yi ni tha ma ha nyid// sum cu rtsa gnyis pa nyid dang*// bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa sra

nyid la// 'og gi char ni sgrub pa pos// me dang sbyar bar bya ba nyid// lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// bzhi bcu gsum pa bhu nyid dag ni// dbyangs yig lnga pa nyid dang sbyar// gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dza dang*// lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// yi ge bzhi bcu lnga pa bhā ni// dbyangs kyi yi ge gnyis par sbyar// ūṣ+ma yi ni gsum pa dang*// dbyangs yig lnga pa nyid dag kyang*// bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa ldan pa// dpa' bo thams cad rab mchod yin// gzhan yang nyi shu rtsa bdun pa// bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa ra nyid ni// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba// 'di ni rdo rje sems dpa' mchog /an+ta s+thā yi dang po ya dang*// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig pa pa // an+ta s+thā yi gnyis pa ra dang*// de bzhin yang ni sum cu pa// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa shu // dbyangs yig lnga pa nyid dag gis// mdzes pa mchog ni yin par 'dod// lnga pa yi ni dang po dang*// lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa pā nyid ni// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang sbyar ba// lha rnams thams cad sgrub pa ni// 'di nyid yin par the tshom med// ūṣ+ma yi ni dang po nyid// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa sha 'ang*// dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa dang sbyar// de bzhin yi ge ta de nyid dang*// bzhi pa'i dang po ga ta nga yin dang*// ūṣ+ma'i dang po gang yin dang*// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa drug pa shū // dbyangs yig drug pa dang yang sbyar// dgra rnams nges par gcod byed yin// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa la // dang po'i gnyis pa 'a gang yin dang*// gsum pa'i dang po nyid dag dang*// an+ta s+thā yi bzhi pa dang*// dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar bar bya// de bzhin bco lnga pa dang sbyar// dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa yin// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa dgur 'a ṭ+wāṃ gyur// dang po'i gsum pa ga gang yin dang*// bzhi pa'i bzhi pa gang yin dang*// yi ge drug cu rtsa gcig dhā nyid// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dag dang sbyar// 'di nyid mchog ni yin par bshad// an+ta swā yi gnyis pa dang*// yi ge drug cu rtsa gnyis

ri pa// dbyangs yig gsum par sbyar ba ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi mchog tu 'dod// gsum pa yi yang lnga pa dang*// yi ge drug cu rtsa ṇa gsum nyid// dbyangs yig bcu gcig dag dang ldan// mdzes pa'i yi ge kun mchog nyid// yi ge byā bya ni de nas blang*// dang po yi ni bzhi pa dang*// de bzhin drug cu rtsa gh+ra lnga pa// rdo rje sems dpas phye ba dag /sa bon 'di ni lha rdzas mchog /grub sbyin thar pa sbyin chen po// de nas brgyad pa nyid dag dang*// yi ge drug cu dzi rtsa drug pa// dbyangs yig gsum pa dang yang sbyar// bya ba kun la grub sbyin par// de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// bzhi pa'i lnga pa gang yin dang*// yi ge drug cu rtsa ba nā dun pa// dbyangs yig gnyis par yang dag ldan// rnal 'byor ma yi dgongs pa kun// 'di nyid yin par the tshom med// lnga pa yi yang lnga pa dang*// drug cu brgyad pa m+ba nyid la yang*// der ni yi ge pa sbyar ba// sa bon yi ge 'di yi ni// 'og gi char ni brtag par bya// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bdun ra pa// bzhi pa yi ni bzhi pa dha dang*// slar yang nyi shu rtsa bdun pa// yi ge bdun cu rtsa rā gcig pa// dbyangs yig gnyis pa yang dag sbyar// yi ge kun la mdzes pa ni// 'di nyid yin par the tshom med// de bzhin nyi shu ya rtsa drug pa// nyi shu rtsa ma lnga yang dag blang*// sum cu rtsa gsum nyid dag dang*// bdun cu rtsa bzhi dha pa nyid ni// dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar ba dag /gdong nas grub pa yin par ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas gsungs// bzhi pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// yi ge bdud cu lnga dhū/ pa nyid// ma mo drug pa dang ldan pa// 'di ni rnal 'byor rab mchog ste// bya ba kun la dam pa yin// lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang*// bdun cu rtsa drug pa nyid ni// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan cing*// nyi ma yis ni dbye ba ste// yi ge pa la de

m+bā sbyar bya// mchog tu mdzes pa gzhan yod min// bzhi pa yi yang lnga pa dang*// yi ge bdun cu rtsa bdun n+dha pa// der ni dha dang sbyar bar bya// sa bon 'di ni lha rdzas mchog /mkha' 'gro ma yi mdzes par 'dod// dang po'i dang po nyid dag dang*// bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa kā nyid ni// dbyangs yig gnyis pa dang ldan cing*// sa bon 'di ni mchog bzang po// rgyu yi mchog ni yin par 'dod// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bdu ra na pa// an+tas+thā yi bzhi pa wa dang*// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig pa// yi ge brgyad cu rtsa ga pu cig pa// bzhi pa'i mtha' yi khyad par byed// gdod nas sgrub byed 'di yin te// dngos grub kun la 'jug byed pa'o// ūṣ+ma yi ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge brgyad cu rtsa ṣā gnyis pa// dbyangs yig gnyis dang sbyar bar bya// zhes pa dang*// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa drug ya pa'o// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa ka ra ka ra'i rtsa sngags btu ba la gsum/ brgyad tshan dang po'i sngags btu ba/ brgyad tshan bar pa'i sngags btu ba/ brgyad tshan tha ma'i sngags btu ba'o// dang po ni/ lo tsā ba gnyis 'dus kyis bsgyur ba'i rtsa rgyud le'u lnga pa las/ dang po'i dang po nyid dang ni// mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa ra nyid// a sde dang por byas pa'i/ gnyis pa yi ni dang ka po nyid// drug pa yi yang gnyis pa ra 'o// dang po yi ni dang po dang*// gnyis 'dus 'gyur gyi rtsa rgyud le'u bdun pa las/ ma mo rnams las lnga pa nyid// de bzhin yi ge brgyad cu brgyad ku // mthar gnas gnyis pa de bzhin te// ma mo dag las lnga pa nyid// yi ge brgyad cu rtsa dgu pa ru // a sde nas/ gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang*// ma mo rnams las lnga pa nyid// de bzhin yi ge dgu cu pa ku // a sde nas/ bdun pa yi ni gnyis pa dang*// ma mo dag las lnga pa dang*// yi ge dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa ru // drug pa yi yang bzhi pa wa dang*// bzhi pa yi yang lnga pa la// bzhi pa yis ni sbyar bar

n+dha bya// mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa dang*// a sde nas/ lnga pa yi yang lnga pa la// bzhi pa yis ni gdan du byas// a sde nas/ lnga pa yi ni dang po la// 'og tu me yi gdan dang ldan// ma mo rnams las gnyis pa nyid// yi ge dgu bcu rtsa drug pa trā // ūṣ+ma ṇa yi gsum sa de bzhin// mthar gnas pa yi dang po ya yang*// bzhi pa yi ni dang po nyid// me yis gdan du byas pa'o// dbyangs dag las ni gnyis pa dang*// yi ge dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa/ trā /bdun pa yi ni gsum pa dang*// yi ge brgya pa sa yang dag ldan// gdug pa rnams ni skrag byed cing*// sngags pa rnams la bde 'byung byed// drug pa yi ni dang po gang*/ ya /ka ṣar grags pa dang po gzung*// dbyangs rnams kyi ni bcu gsum pa// yi ge gnyis par yang dag ldan/ k+ṣa /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// mthar gnas pa yi dang po gang ya // de bzhin yang ni ril po nyid// dbyangs las bcu gsum pa nyid dang*// yi ge lnga pa yang dag ldan/ k+ṣo /gdug pa rnams ni za byed cing*// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bde 'bab pa'o// lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa bha dang*// a sde nas/ bdun pa yi yang dang po dang ya // ūṣ+ma ṇa yi bzhi pa gzung*// dbyangs rnams las ni bcu bzhi nyid// yi ge brgyad par yang dag 'og gi dag sgras rasta bstan/ ldan// bco lnga pa yis gdan du byas// bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa la// rdo rje sems dpas phye ba dag /dbyangs dag las ni bcu bzhi pa// yi ge dgu par yang dag ldan/ hrauṃ /spyi bor thig les mtshan pa'o// sgrub por mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi// khyad par du ni dga' byed pa'o// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi bzhi pa nyid// 'od byed gdan du byas hraḥ pa'o// bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa la// 'og tu yang ni me yi gdan// tsheg drag dang ni yang dag ldan hraḥ // lnga pa yi ni gnyis pa dang*// dbyangs rnams las ni bcu gcig pa// bcu gnyis pa yi yang dag ldan phaṃ // spyi bor thig les mtshan pa'o// 'byung po thams cad skrag byed cing*// sgrub po rnams la phan 'byung ba'o// de bzhin nyi shu gnyis pa nyid// bcu gcig pa ni yang dag ldan// yi ge bcu gsum pa nyid la// thig les rnam par mtshan pa'o/

beṃ /'byung po thams cad skrag 'byung dang*// sgrub po rnams la phan 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa brgyad tshan bar pa'i sngags btu ba ni/ a sde nas/ drug pa yi ni gnyis nyid pa dang*// de bzhin bcu gcig par ma ni nges// slar yang nyi shu rtsa gnyis pha gzung*// gsum pa yi ni dang po na dang*// bzhi pa yi ni gsum pa nga dang*// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi bzhi pa nyid ha // a sde nas/ lnga pa yi ni gsum pa nga dang*// bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa ha dang*// nyi shu gcig pa pa de nas btu// gnyis pa yi ni dang po tsa dang*// lnga pa yi ni dang por pa nges// a sde nas/ gnyis las drug pa'i yi tsa ge'o// lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa bha dang*// de bzhin ka ṣar k+ṣa grags pa nyid// nyi shu bzhi pa de nas btu// slar yang ril k+ṣa po ji bzhin dang*// lnga pa yi ni gsum pa ba dang*// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi gsum pa sa dang*// mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa nyid// dbyangs rnams las ni lnga pa nyid// yi ge sum cu gnyis par ldan ru // a sde nas/ lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// dbyangs rnams las ni gsum pa dang*// yi ge sum cu gsum par ldan b+dha // slar yang 'od byed sbyin par bya// thabyangs kyi gnyis pa nyid dang ni// yi ge sum cu bzhi par ra ldan// yi ge nyi shu'i 'og tu ni// bcu drug pa ni gdan du bya// 'og tu me yis gsal byas n+t+ra pa// lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang*// dbyangs rnams las ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge sum cu drug par mā ldan// mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang*// thog ma'i gnyis par yang dag ldan// yi ge sum cu rtsa bdun lā pa// lnga pa yi ni gsum pa ba dang*// drug pa yi yang gsum pa 'a dang*// mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa dang*// nyi shu lnga pas khyad par dbye// dbyangs las gsum pa yang dag ldan// yi ge bzhi bcu pa m+bi la'o// bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang*// ma mo bcu gcig yang dag ldan// yi ge bzhi bcu rtsa d+na gcig pa/ a sde nas/ /gnyis pa yi na 'a gsum pa la// nyi ma'i bu yis khyad par dbye// dbyangs dag las ni gsum pa nyid// yi ge bzhi bcu gnyis par lda

gri na// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi bzhi pa dang*// 'og tu bco lnga pa yis gad h+ṇa na// dang po yi yang gsum pa dang*// de nas me yis gdan du bya// dbyangs dag las ni gsum pa nyid// yi ge bzhi bcu bzhi par lda gra na// bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// 'og tu bco lnga pa yis gad h+ṇa na// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi gsum pa sa nyid// lnga pa yi yang dang po la// bcu drug pa yis gad bha na du'o// de nas nyi shu gcig pa blang*// ma mo las ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge bzhi bcu brgyad par lda pā na// bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang*// dbyangs dag las ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge bzhi bcu dgu par ldan/ tā /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa la dang*/ a sde nas/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa ga dang*// bzhi pa yi ni dang po da ta nga*// lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// ma mo rnams las lnga pa nyid// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa gsum lda

bhū na/ a sde nas/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa dang*// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa// thig les kyang ni rnam brgyan pa'o// dang po yi ni gsum pa dang*// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa gāṃ // spyi bor thig les mtshan pa las// dbyangs kyi gnyis pa sbyar ba'o// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi gsum pa sa nyid// de bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig pa// 'od byed mnyam par mnan pa'o// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa// spyi bor thig les mnan r+paṃ pa'o// lnga pa yi ni gsum pa dang*// dbyangs rnams las ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge lnga bcu rtsa bā brgyad pa// bzhi pa yi dang po dang*/ a sde nas/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa la// me yis steng nas gsal rdza bar bya// mthar gnas pa'i dang ya po gsungs// de nas yi ge bcu drug 'og ta /a sde nas/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa dang*// spyi bor me yi yi ges ma rdza tshan// de bzhin nyi shu drug pa ya nyid/ a sde nas/ /dang po yi ni dang po dang*// ma mo las ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge drug cu rtsa lnga pa ā 'o/ /a sde nas/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po da ka nga*// gsum pa yi ni bzhi pa la// bcu gsum pa yis mnan ha pa'o/ /a sde nas/ /dang po'i dang po de bzhin te// ma mo las ni gnyis pa nyid// yi ge drug cu brgyad par lda ā na// dngos grub thams cad 'gugs byed cing*// sgrub po rnams la dpal sbyin pa'o/ /a sde nas/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po da ka nga*// gsum pa yi ni bzhi pa yin// steng du bcu gsum pa ḍ+ḍha nyid dang*// ūṣ+ma ṇa yi bzhi pa la// nyi shu bdun pas gdan du byas// ma mo las ni bzhi pa nyid// yi ge bdun cu gcig par lda hrī na// thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan// ya yig brgyad pa'i sa bon la// 'od byed kyis ni gsal byas pa// ma mo las ni bzhi pa nyid// yi ge bdun cu gnyis par lda hrīṃ na// sems can thams cad dbang byed pa// thig le yis ni mnyam par mnan// gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa la// bco lnga pa yis gdan du bya// dbyangs kyi bcu bzhi par nges ldan// yi ge bdun cu rtsa ga

dzauṃn sum pa'o// gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa la// gsum pa'i lnga pa la ni bskyon// ma mo las ni bcu bzhi pa// yi ge bdun cu bzhi par ldan/ dzaṇau/ /de bzhin thig les rnam brgyan pa'o// gsum pa brgyad tshan tha ma'i sngags btu ba ni// ka ṣa'i sa bon btus nas ni// nyi shu lnga pas gdan du bya// dbyangs rnams las ni gnyis pa nyid/ 'di nas tshig rkang bcu bzhi mngon brjod 'brog 'gyur las bskangs// yi ge bdun cu lnga dang sbyar/ k+ṣamarayuṃ /thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan// ril po mdzes pa btus nas ni// yi ge ma yi gdan du bya// phyi mo yi ni gnyis pa yang*// yi ge bdun cu drug dang sbyar/ k+ṣamarayuṃ /ūṣ+ma ṇa yi bzhi pa nyid// bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// thig le gnyis kyis yang dag brgyan// phyi mo yi ni gnyis pa yang*// yi ge bdun cu bdun dang sbyar/ k+ṣamarayuṃ/ /ya sogs brgyad pa'i sa bon dang*// ma mo'i bzhi pa nyid dang ni// yi ge bdun cu brgyad hīṃ dang sbyar// thig les mgo la mnan par bya// de bzhin sum cu gsum par nges// dbyangs yig bzhi pa dag kyang ni// yi ge bdun cu dgu dang sbya hrīṃ ra/ 'dir mngon brjod las haṃ gnyis gcig tu bgrangs pa lta bur snang yang*/ so sor bgrangs nas lus kyi yi ge grangs brgya go brgyad du byed pa lo tsā ba gnyis 'dus kyi 'gyur gyi dgongs pa ltar legs par rjes gsungs so/ /thig le sgra yis bskyed pa ste// thig les kyang ni rnam par brgyan// lnga pa'i bdag nyid yongs btus la// yang ni de la gnyis par nges// dbyangs rnams las ni drug pa nyid// rta yi rgyal po skyed pa la hūm̐hūm̐ // thig le nā das rnam brgyan pa/ a sde nas/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang*// mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang*// de bzhin sum cu rtsa gnyis pa// drug pa yi ni gsum pa dang*// bdun pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// drug pa'i gsum pa de bzhin te/

a sde nas/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang*// drug pa yi ni gsum pa ste// gnyis gnyis rkang pa bzhi yin no// zhes pa dang*/ dbyangs rnams las ni gsum pa nyid// yi ge bcu drug la ldan no/ ki li ki li si li si li hi li hi li dhi li dhi li/ /yi ge'i grangs ni brgya yin te// dgu bcu dang ni rtsa brgyad do// zhes pa'o// gsum pa rtsa sngags kyi thog mtha' yi ge btu ba ni/ le'u bdun pa las/ yi ge oṃ ni dang por te// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ni tha mar sbyar// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbus su oṃ dang dhi li'i rjes su hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa bri'o// gnyis pa yab kyi snying po dang nye snying btu ba ni/ le'u brgyad par/ hā swā raṃ ba saṃ la dzā nī ki ḍā phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐ kaṃ ru ru he he dz+rab shrī oṃ/ zhes snying po dang*/ le'u bcu gnyis par/ ṭapha hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ha hrīḥ.oṃ/ zhes nye snying go ldog tu yod pa lugs mthun du rtsa sngags la mthud nas bri ba'o// gsum pa yum gyi snying po dang nye snying btu ba ni/ le'u lnga bcu par/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes yum gyi snying po lugs mthun du 'byung ba ltar dang*/ le'u bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad par/ hā swā ṭapha hūm̐ hūm̐ ye nīr+ṇa wa dz+rab ye nī ki ḍā d+dhabu rbas oṃ/ zhes nye snying lugs ldog tu 'byung ba lugs mthun du yab la mthud nas bri ba'o// bzhi pa yab yum gyi go cha'i sngags gnyis btu ba ni/ le'u drug pa las/ ya sogs brgyad pa'i sa bon dang*// de bzhin gug kyed bcu gnyis kyi// yi ge tha ma dor byas pa// yan lag drug he ru kar brjod// dpa' bo drug dang mnyam sbyor ba// yi ge gcig tu yang dag gnas// oṃ na ma swāhā bau ṣaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dang yang dag ldan// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bo ṣaṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa ham̐/ zhes yab kyi go cha drug dang*/ le'u brgyad pa las/

phaṭa hūm̐ hri ྃhrim̐ ham̐ oṃ rnams// yi ge bam̐ dang oṃ dang ni// yi ge moṃ dang hrīṃ nyid dang*/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa dang sbyar ba ni// rnal 'byor ma ni drug tu bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hri ྃmoṃ/ hre ྃhri/ྃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces yum gyi go cha drug rnams yum gyi nye snying la mthud nas bri ba'o// gnyis pa sngags byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa ni/ de nas btus pa'i sngags 'khor de btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mañji btsugs pa'i khar bzhag la/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi= byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba re re= gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po= phaṭa phaṭa dud ka rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po= sku gsum go 'phang tshe 'dir mngon gyur cig /ces lha lnga'i dbang chog bde chen snying po ltar bsgrub cing mchod/ de nas yig cha logs su gsal ba ltar tshogs 'khor sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar bya'o// gsum pa sngags kyi rje gnang bya tshul ni/ slob ma rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro hes bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams kyi go sar pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ slob ma rnams re re nas bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog mthing ga zhes pa nas/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can du gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis gtso bo yab yum du bskyed la/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon dang*/ slob ma gsum ga he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gsal pa'i dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po la rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar bla slob gnyis kas gsal btab la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shwā ya/ ma hā kawāg+ni saṃ ni bhā ya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭot+kā ṭā ya/ daṃṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/

sa hā sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/ pa ra shu pa sho d+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ gadhā ri ṇe byā gh+ra dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya/ mahā dhū mthān+dha ka ra wa puṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ wan+dha wan+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥpheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba la m+wi ne/ grih+ṇa grih+ṇa/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ gāṃ sar+paṃ bā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍ+ḍha ā kaḍ+ḍha/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ dzauṃn dzauṃn/ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rtsa sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug ste/ lan re re la mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gnyis ka'i sngags phreng oṃ dang bcas pa las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas/ slob ma'i dpral ba'i sngags phreng oṃ dang bcas pa la bstims la gsum bsres byas pa'i mthar/ slob ma rnams kyis rang rang gi dpral ba'i sngags phreng dkar po la dmigs la rtsa sngags lan gsum bzla'o// yang mdun bskyed bla slob gsum ga'i mgrin par zla ba'i steng du āḥdamar po la yab yum gyi snying po gnyis kyis bskor ba gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro zhes sogs snying po gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa'i lan re re la/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i sngags phreng āḥdang bcas pa las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas/ slob ma'i mgrin pa'i sngags phreng āḥdang bcas pa la bstims la gsum bsres byas pa'i mthar/ slob ma rnams kyis rang rang gi mgrin pa'i sngags phreng dmar po la dmigs la snying po gnyis lan bdun re bzla'o// yang mdun bskyed bla slob gsum ga'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po la yab yum gyi nye snying gnyis kyis bskor ba gsal btab la oṃ hrīḥha ha zhes sogs dang*/

oṃ sarba bud+dha zhes sogs nye snying gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa'i lan re re la/ mdun bskyed dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng hūm̐ dang bcas pa las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas/ slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags phreng hūm̐ dang bcas pa la bstims la gsum bsres byas pa'i mthar/ slob ma rnams kyi snying ga'i sngags phreng sngon po la dmigs la nye snying gnyis lan nyer gcig re bzla'o// go cha'i rjes gnang la/ sngags rang rang gi gnas su dgod mi dgos shing*/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭ he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa ham̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ boṃ/ ham̐ yoṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces rjes zlos lan gsum re byas pas/ slob ma rang rang gi lus kyi ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas sngags de rnams tshur zhugs te sha lpags kyi bar thams cad khyab pas srung ba chen por gyur par bsam mo// de nas slob dpon gyis btu gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi yi ge rnams la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis byug cing*/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor reg ste dbyangs gsal brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad spyi bo nas ā li kā li'i rnam pas lus la zhugs pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de bzhin du btus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rtsa sngags la byug cing spyi bo dang*/ snying po gnyis la byug cing mgrin pa dang*/ nye snying gnyis la byug cing snying gar reg pas/ gnas de dag nas mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas sngags gsum gyi yig 'bru'i rnam par lus la zhugs pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de nas go cha'i sngags la byug cing spyi bor reg pas go cha brtan cing byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum zlos la me tog bla ma la dbul/ bla mas de blangs te sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag la/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod do// de nas nang mchod kyis btus pa'i yi ge rnams bkrus la/ bla ma rang gis kyang btung zhing lus la byug slob ma rnams kyi yang gnas gsum du byug cing*/ khyor bar byin pa 'thungs shing lus la byugs pas/ lus kyi cha shas rnams su de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// gsum pa mjug chog ni/ slob ma rnams kyi snying gar zla ba la rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po zhes sogs go cha gnyis dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces sogs tsham rngams sngags kyi srung ba byas la/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul rjes/ de ltar dpal ldan 'khor lo bde mchog gi /zhes sogs smon lam dang*/ rab yangs kun gsal khyon 'gengs dkyil 'khor lha// zhes sogs kyis shis pa brjod par bya'o// smras pa/ nyung ngu'i rtsa rgyud zla ba'i ma ma ru// sbas pa'i yid skyob rin chen rnam pa bzhi// lung rigs skya ba 'chang ba'i blo bzang gi// ded dpon mchog des nyer blangs byi dor mdzad// gang de grub mchog nyi zla rnam gnyis kyis// rang gzhung rgyal mtshan tog tu rab bkod nas// dpyod ldan rnams kyi yid la dgos rgu'i char// bsnyil bas nor 'dzin khyon yang dog por byas// 'on te rnam dpyod gzugs 'dzin kun rmongs kyi// rab rib mthug pos sbags pa bdag 'dra'i 'gror// phan phyir tshig nyung don gsal kañca na'i// thur ma'i rjes su snyegs 'di bdag gis bskrun// tshul 'dir 'bad las thob pa'i legs byas mthus// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dngos po myur grub nas// gson gshin 'brel thogs kyis mtshon lus can kun// gnas skabs mthar thug phan dang bder 'god shog

/ces dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rin chen bzhi'i sngags btus nas byin gyis brlab tshul mdor bsdus go bde bar brjod pa'i legs bshad gser gyi thur ma zhes bya ba 'di ni 'di ga'i rtsa rgyud/ sbas don kun gsal/ rin chen phreng ba/ nyi ma'i snying po rnams la legs par brtag nas snying po'i bcud phyung ste/ gser 'phyang gi lo la dge slong dharma bha dras dngul chu'i ri phug tu sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
